agency: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
title: ODNI-UAP-D001, USPER Narrative, Senior USIC Official
doc_notes: This document is a first-hand narrative by a senior U.S. intelligence official describing multiple UAP encounters during a helicopter mission in late 2025.

incidents.summary: Ground team observed a super-hot object low to the ground that split in two and changed direction.
incidents.quote: super-hot, low to the ground, and moving east then south at high speed

incidents.summary: Object rose from the ground, approached within ten feet of the helicopter, dropped below, and split in two before speeding away.
incidents.quote: approached within ten feet of the helicopter, dropped below us, and then sped away

incidents.summary: Countless orange orbs swarming in all directions against the mountain backdrop.
incidents.quote: countless orange orbs swarming in all directions

incidents.summary: Two large oval-shaped orbs flared up side-by-side near the helicopter, followed by others forming a T-formation.
incidents.color: orange with white or yellow center
incidents.quote: two large orbs flare up side-by-side, close to the helicopter

incidents.summary: Orbs appeared above fighter jets, matching their speed and flight path in horizontal formation.
incidents.quote: same type of orbs appeared directly above the fighters

incidents.summary: Orange orbs flared up and down around the helicopter, forming a triangle.
incidents.quote: orange orbs flaring up and down around us for several minutes, forming a distinct triangle
